verdict.rationale: Spline documents an MCP server that lets agents drive the open editor, and separately documents manual exports (code, self-hosted ZIP, spline-viewer). No evidence shows an agent can trigger rendering, screenshots, image output, or production exports through a programmatic surface. The Code API is a runtime interaction library, and probes found no REST or OpenAPI surface, so the MCP and export features cannot be combined into credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can render and export designs — screenshots, images, or production formats — through a documented programmatic surface
